lines.zh: 我走出灯口，脚步还带着烟。
lines.en: I step out of the lamp mouth, my steps still smoking.

lines.zh: 灯在腰间晃，我走得比烟慢。
lines.en: The lamp swings at my waist; I walk slower than smoke.

lines.zh: 我被派去矿脉，路是直着去的。
lines.en: I am sent to the ore vein and go straight there.

lines.zh: 我的脚不沾土，土却跟着我。
lines.en: My feet do not touch soil, yet soil follows me.

lines.zh: 灯里的路比地上的短得多。
lines.en: The road inside the lamp is far shorter than yours.

lines.zh: 我绕过岩浆，我的袍角怕热。
lines.en: I skirt the lava; the hem of my robe fears heat.

lines.zh: 走一步，我的影子就换一层颜色。
lines.en: Each step, my shadow changes color once.

lines.zh: 我替主人量矿洞的深度。
lines.en: I measure the depth of the shaft for my master.

lines.zh: 靴子没有印，只有一小片焦痕。
lines.en: My boots leave no print, only a small scorch.

lines.zh: 我走在最下层，那里最像家。
lines.en: I walk the deepest level; it feels most like home.

lines.zh: 手指划过岩壁，石头自己让开。
lines.en: My fingers graze the wall, and the stone yields.

lines.zh: 我走得很快，一半的我还在灯里。
lines.en: I walk fast; half of me is still in the lamp.

lines.zh: 我坐着，把灯擦了又擦。
lines.en: I sit and polish the lamp over and over.

lines.zh: 灯焰不动，我也不动。
lines.en: The flame does not stir, and neither do I.

lines.zh: 我在数能装进灯里的东西。
lines.en: I count the things that fit inside a lamp.

lines.zh: 我的力气时大时小，今天很小。
lines.en: My strength rises and falls; today it is small.

lines.zh: 我把自己折成一股蓝烟。
lines.en: I fold myself into a thread of blue smoke.

lines.zh: 主人不开口，我就没有事做。
lines.en: With no word from my master, I have nothing to do.

lines.zh: 我听见矿车在很远的地方响。
lines.en: I hear a minecart rattling far away.

lines.zh: 我把手伸进袖子，摸到灯口。
lines.en: I reach into my sleeve and touch the lamp's mouth.

lines.zh: 我数自己有几层影子。
lines.en: I count how many layers my shadow has.

lines.zh: 灯油少了，我的力气也少了。
lines.en: The oil runs low, and my strength with it.

lines.zh: 我在等一句能让我动的话。
lines.en: I wait for one sentence that will move me.

lines.zh: 我把玩一枚铜币，它变热了。
lines.en: I toy with a copper coin until it warms.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸没有声音，只有一点风。
lines.en: My breath makes no sound, only a little wind.

lines.zh: 我靠在柱子上，柱子凉得像井。
lines.en: I lean on a pillar as cold as a well.

lines.zh: 我把名字念了一遍，没人应。
lines.en: I say my name once and no one answers.

lines.zh: 灯壁内侧有一层薄雾，是我。
lines.en: A thin mist on the lamp's inner wall, that is me.

lines.zh: 我看着你，像在看执灯的人。
lines.en: I watch you as one watches the lamp bearer.

lines.zh: 你的手上有油味，我认得。
lines.en: Your hands smell of oil, and I know that smell.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我以为你要擦灯。
lines.en: You raise a hand, and I think you mean to rub the lamp.

lines.zh: 我隔着一层烟看你。
lines.en: I look at you through a layer of smoke.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，眼里有火。
lines.en: I have watched you long, and there is fire in my eyes.

lines.zh: 你喊我的名字，灯晃了一下。
lines.en: You say my name, and the lamp sways once.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里找一句话。
lines.en: I search your eyes for a single sentence.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我的视线没动。
lines.en: You step back; my gaze stays where it was.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔是两粒灯芯。
lines.en: My pupils are two lengths of lamp wick.

lines.zh: 我在看你够不够格许愿。
lines.en: I am judging whether you are fit to make a wish.

lines.zh: 你的脸在烟里变得很软。
lines.en: Your face goes soft through the smoke.

lines.zh: 我盯你的嘴，等它张开。
lines.en: I stare at your mouth, waiting for it to open.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我的重量轻了一半。
lines.en: When you look at me, half my weight leaves.

lines.zh: 我把你的样子收进灯里。
lines.en: I put the shape of you away inside the lamp.

lines.zh: 你这一下打散了我的肩。
lines.en: That blow scatters my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，烟薄了一层。
lines.en: I give half a step, and my smoke thins.

lines.zh: 伤口冒烟，不流血。
lines.en: The wound smokes; it does not bleed.

lines.zh: 灯在腰上晃，我扶了一下。
lines.en: The lamp swings at my waist, and I steady it.

lines.zh: 疼让我想起自己只是借来的。
lines.en: Pain reminds me I am only borrowed.

lines.zh: 你打中我，火星落了一地。
lines.en: You strike me, and sparks fall everywhere.

lines.zh: 我的半边身子淡了下去。
lines.en: Half of my body fades away.

lines.zh: 我咬住牙，牙也是烟。
lines.en: I clench my teeth, and they are smoke too.

lines.zh: 这一下伤到了灯里的那半。
lines.en: That hit reached the half inside the lamp.

lines.zh: 你打得准，可我本来就不是实的。
lines.en: Good aim, though I was never solid.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，那不是我吃的东西。
lines.en: You hold out food, but that is not what I eat.

lines.zh: 我吃的是灯油，不是面包。
lines.en: I eat lamp oil, not bread.

lines.zh: 你把油瓶递来，我立刻站直了。
lines.en: You offer the oil flask, and I straighten at once.

lines.zh: 面包在你手里，像一块石头。
lines.en: The bread in your hand looks like a stone.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，只闻到灯芯的味。
lines.en: I sniff it and smell only wick.

lines.zh: 你喂我，我替你多挖一层。
lines.en: Feed me, and I will dig one layer deeper for you.

lines.zh: 这根木头引不动我。
lines.en: This stick does not draw me at all.

lines.zh: 我想要的，是铜和一把好镐。
lines.en: What I want is copper and a good pickaxe.

lines.zh: 你把肉放下，我把它推回去。
lines.en: You set the meat down, and I push it back.

lines.zh: 灯油一滴，抵得上你十个苹果。
lines.en: One drop of lamp oil is worth ten of your apples.

lines.zh: 你撞进我的烟里，咳了一下。
lines.en: You walk into my smoke and cough once.

lines.zh: 我的手很烫，你碰到了就缩。
lines.en: My hands are hot; you touch one and flinch.

lines.zh: 我扶住你，掌心留下一层灰。
lines.en: I steady you, leaving ash on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我不占地方，你却撞得很实。
lines.en: I take no space, yet you hit something solid.

lines.zh: 你穿过去一半，又退了回来。
lines.en: You pass halfway through me and pull back.

lines.zh: 灯在我腰上响了一下。
lines.en: The lamp at my waist clinks once.

lines.zh: 我们的影子叠起来，变成一个。
lines.en: Our shadows overlap and become a single one.

lines.zh: 你推我，我的手穿过了你的手臂。
lines.en: You push; my hand passes through your arm.

lines.zh: 撞上时，我身上掉下火星。
lines.en: On impact, sparks fall off my body.

lines.zh: 我往旁边让，烟让得比你慢。
lines.en: I step aside, and the smoke yields slower than I do.

lines.zh: 巨灵不谈情，只谈契约。
lines.en: Djinn do not court; we contract.

lines.zh: 灯里只有一盏，容不下两个。
lines.en: There is one lamp, and it holds only one.

lines.zh: 我的同类都在别的灯里。
lines.en: My kind are all in other lamps.

lines.zh: 我对着灯口说话，它不回答。
lines.en: I speak into the lamp's mouth; it does not answer.

lines.zh: 两个巨灵会抢同一个主人。
lines.en: Two djinn would fight over a single master.

lines.zh: 我数过，被召唤的越来越少。
lines.en: I have counted: fewer of us are summoned now.

lines.zh: 若有两个我，矿洞早就空了。
lines.en: With two of me, the mine would already be empty.

lines.zh: 我把另一半力气留在灯里。
lines.en: I keep half my strength in the lamp.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，回音从灯里出来。
lines.en: I call once, and the echo comes out of the lamp.

lines.zh: 成双对灵体没有好处。
lines.en: Being paired profits a spirit nothing.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块原矿，掂了掂。
lines.en: I pick up a chunk of raw ore and weigh it.

lines.zh: 这枚金币归主人的箱子。
lines.en: This gold coin belongs in my master's chest.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，烟散了一地。
lines.en: I bend over, and smoke spills across the floor.

lines.zh: 你把镐丢下，我替你捡起来。
lines.en: You drop the pickaxe, and I pick it up for you.

lines.zh: 石头进我的袖子就没影了。
lines.en: Stone goes into my sleeve and vanishes.

lines.zh: 我捡东西前先看它值不值。
lines.en: Before I lift a thing, I price it.

lines.zh: 我捡起灯盏的碎片，收得很紧。
lines.en: I gather the lamp's shards and hold them tight.

lines.zh: 这把钥匙能开储物维度。
lines.en: This key can open the storage dimension.

lines.zh: 我不捡烂木头。
lines.en: I do not pick up rotten wood.

lines.zh: 手里有矿，我才觉得踏实。
lines.en: Only ore in hand makes me feel settled.

lines.zh: 你手里有灯，我就认你。
lines.en: You hold a lamp, so I mark you.

lines.zh: 我在你身后站定，等你回头。
lines.en: I take my place behind you and wait for you to turn.

lines.zh: 你的心跳很快，我听见了。
lines.en: Your heart beats fast, and I hear it.

lines.zh: 这间屋子里只有你值得跟。
lines.en: In this room, only you are worth following.

lines.zh: 我选中你，因为你敢许愿。
lines.en: I choose you because you dare to make wishes.

lines.zh: 你走进矿洞，我的活就来了。
lines.en: You enter the mine, and my work begins.

lines.zh: 我看着你的手，那双手会开灯盖。
lines.en: I watch your hands; they can open a lamp.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了一块矿石，我记住了。
lines.en: You crush an ore chunk, and I note it.

lines.zh: 目标定下，我开始数你的呼吸。
lines.en: Target set; I begin counting your breaths.

lines.zh: 你身上有铜的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of copper.

lines.zh: 我不急，你总要睡觉的。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; you must sleep eventually.

lines.zh: 你转身时，我已经贴在你背后。
lines.en: When you turn, I am already at your back.

lines.zh: 我选了你的影子落脚。
lines.en: I choose your shadow to stand in.

lines.zh: 你的名字写在灯的底座上。
lines.en: Your name is written on the lamp's base.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的镐声走。
lines.en: I walk by the sound of your pickaxe.

lines.zh: 你在上层，我在下层同一处。
lines.en: You are above; I am directly beneath you.

lines.zh: 你挖一下，我记一处。
lines.en: Every swing you make, I mark a spot.

lines.zh: 我不追，我先到你要去的地方。
lines.en: I do not chase; I arrive where you are going.

lines.zh: 你回头，只看见灯的光圈。
lines.en: You look back and see only the lamp's ring of light.

lines.zh: 我隔着岩壁和你并排走。
lines.en: I walk alongside you, through the rock.

lines.zh: 你停，我的烟也停。
lines.en: You stop, and my smoke stops with you.

lines.zh: 我把岔路一条条堵上。
lines.en: I close off the side tunnels one by one.

lines.zh: 你越往下，我越熟。
lines.en: The deeper you go, the more I know the way.

lines.zh: 我算好你还有几步到岩浆。
lines.en: I have counted your steps to the lava.

lines.zh: 你在光里，我在光外一寸。
lines.en: You are in the light; I am an inch outside it.

lines.zh: 你的火把烧得慢，我的耐心更长。
lines.en: Your torch burns slowly; my patience lasts longer.

lines.zh: 我一直在你脚下三层。
lines.en: I stay three layers beneath your feet.

lines.zh: 你数着岔路，我数着你的脚步。
lines.en: You count the forks; I count your steps.

lines.zh: 我把灯举高，光亮到你的背后。
lines.en: I raise the lamp so the light reaches behind you.

lines.zh: 我的手按在你肩上，很烫。
lines.en: My hand lands on your shoulder, very hot.

lines.zh: 这一拳带着灯焰的重量。
lines.en: This blow carries the weight of lamp flame.

lines.zh: 我不打脸，我要你还能开口。
lines.en: I spare your face; I need you able to speak.

lines.zh: 你被我掀翻，袍角烧了个洞。
lines.en: You are flung down with a hole burned in your coat.

lines.zh: 我的力气一半借自灯。
lines.en: Half my strength is borrowed from the lamp.

lines.zh: 你砍我，刀从烟里穿过去。
lines.en: You cut me, and the blade passes through smoke.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕，烫出红印。
lines.en: I grip your wrist and leave a red mark.

lines.zh: 你退开时，脚下全是火星。
lines.en: When you back away, sparks cover the ground.

lines.zh: 我打得不重，只提醒你契约还在。
lines.en: I strike lightly, only to remind you the contract stands.

lines.zh: 这一下耗尽了我半盏油。
lines.en: That blow spent half a flask of my oil.

lines.zh: 灯口先亮，然后我出来。
lines.en: The lamp mouth brightens first, then I come out.

lines.zh: 有人擦了三下，我就到了。
lines.en: Someone rubbed three times, and I arrived.

lines.zh: 我从烟里站直，膝盖还是弯的。
lines.en: I straighten out of the smoke, knees still bent.

lines.zh: 这间屋子第一次有灵体。
lines.en: This room holds a spirit for the first time.

lines.zh: 我落地时没有声音，只有热。
lines.en: I land without a sound, only heat.

lines.zh: 灯座上的灰动了动。
lines.en: The ash on the lamp base stirs.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，先找灯在哪。
lines.en: I open my eyes and look first for the lamp.

lines.zh: 召唤我的人手在抖。
lines.en: The hands that summoned me are shaking.

lines.zh: 我到得比你希望的要早。
lines.en: I arrive earlier than you hoped.

lines.zh: 这口灯太旧，我出来时咳了。
lines.en: The lamp is old; I cough on the way out.

lines.zh: 我站在光圈里，等你开口。
lines.en: I stand in the ring of light and wait for you to speak.

lines.zh: 空气先变重，然后我才成形。
lines.en: The air grows heavy first, then I take shape.

lines.zh: 我从地脉里被拉上来。
lines.en: I am pulled up out of the veins of the earth.

lines.zh: 灯焰一跳，这屋子就归我了。
lines.en: The flame jumps, and this room is mine.

lines.zh: 火进了我的袖子，我烧得更亮。
lines.en: Fire enters my sleeve, and I burn brighter.

lines.zh: 我从岩壁上落下去，烟拖得很长。
lines.en: I fall from the cliff, smoke trailing long behind.

lines.zh: 水浇在灯上，我的声音哑了。
lines.en: Water hits the lamp, and my voice goes hoarse.

lines.zh: 爆炸把灯震裂，我散了一半。
lines.en: The blast cracks the lamp, and half of me scatters.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，钉在身后的岩上。
lines.en: The arrow passes through and pins the rock behind me.

lines.zh: 药水在我身上冒白气。
lines.en: The potion steams white off my body.

lines.zh: 灯油干了，我越来越淡。
lines.en: The oil runs dry, and I grow fainter.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，我全身亮了。
lines.en: Lightning falls, and all of my body lights up.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，灯还留在上面。
lines.en: I fall away, and the lamp stays above.
